methods.signature: fn post_visit(&mut self, _plan: &dyn ExecutionPlan) -> Result<bool, Self::Error>
methods.summary: Invoked on an `ExecutionPlan` plan *after* all of its child inputs have been visited. The return value is handled the same as the return value of `pre_visit`. The provided default implementation returns `Ok(true)`.
